name: SA public transport concession for Health Care Card holders
summary: Half-price concession travel on SA public transport for eligible Centrelink cardholders, including Health Care Card holders, and full-time students.
who: Eligible Centrelink or DVA cardholders, including Centrelink Health Care Card holders
how: Use the eligibility questionnaire on the page, or call Service SA on 13 23 24.

evidence.claim: Concession travel available to cardholders and full-time students
evidence.quote: eligible Centrelink or Department of Veterans' Affairs (DVA) cardholders and full-time students

evidence.claim: Health Care Card listed as a qualifying card
